caption: The drawing depicts a brown, arch-shaped decorative element featuring a central male figure with a beard and mustache, wearing a brown garment. The figure is framed by a large, oval, yellow wreath topped with a bow and leafy accents. Behind the figure and wreath are blue drapery elements spreading to both sides. Below these elements, a red, white, and blue bunting is draped. On each end of the arch, there are symmetrical arrangements of stacked brown spheres. The overall color scheme includes shades of brown, yellow, blue, red, and white, and the drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Stern Piece
